title.en: Designating the Panamin as the Implementing Arm of the Kilusang Kabuhayan at Kaunlaran for National Minorities
title.orig: Designating the Panamin as the Implementing Arm of the Kilusang Kabuhayan at Kaunlaran for National Minorities

text.en:
The PANAMIN shall serve as the implementing arm of the KKK for national minorities, which shall
be incorporated as part of the provision of the Kilusang Kabuhayan at Kaunlaran as provided for in Executive

In coordination with the KKK Secretariat, PANAMIN shall formulate and set the implementing
policies and guidelines of the KKK program for national minorities on the basis of the expressed aspirations
of the minorities.

All laws, orders, proclamations, rules, regulations, or parts thereof which are inconsistent with any
provisions of this Executive Order, are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect accordingly.
Done in the City of Manila, this 6th day of October, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and eighty-one.
